name: starling
description: Speech-to-speech AI assistant for low-resource Northeast Indian languages

scripts.dev:api: cd services/asr && STARLING_DEVICE=cpu uv run uvicorn starling.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.lab: cd services/asr && STARLING_DEVICE=cpu uv run python -m starling.lab
scripts.smoke: cd services/asr && uv run python -m starling.smoke
scripts.check:ext: node --check apps/extension/background.js && node --check apps/extension/lib/api.js && node --check apps/extension/lib/tabs.js && node --check apps/extension/lib/run.js && node --check apps/extension/content/translate.js && node --check apps/extension/content/agent.js && node --check apps/extension/sidepanel/panel.js && echo 'extension: all scripts parse'
